motivation: D14 original discrete source-weighted phase>=pi interval ODE contribution is small, but sampled FD4 total is cancellation sensitive and hard phase-bin Nq comparison is not a physical error bound. Continuous original variable-H and variable-X10 GE05 first-order on-shell remains open.
exact_frozen_R1_step: On every original R1 step s=t/tau, h_mid=tau*sqrt(H_i H_{i+1}), dz/ds=v, dv/ds=-3*h_mid*v-r^2*(z-X_lin(s)), where X_lin is the original affine-in-step drive and the frozen step_linear_nd is exact for these piecewise step coefficients.
exact_original_action_defect: R_GE05 = d/dt(a^3*v/tau) + a^3*(r/tau)^2*(z-X_true(t)). For the frozen R1 step solution, this equals 3*a^3/tau*(H_true(t)-h_mid/tau)*v_step(t) + a^3*(r/tau)^2*(X_lin(t)-X_true(t)).
conditional_bound: |R_GE05| <= 3*a^3/tau*epsilon_H*|v_step|+a^3*(r/tau)^2*epsilon_X, where original action-source interval envelopes epsilon_H and epsilon_X bound true variable H and true X10 against frozen piecewise h_mid/tau and original affine X_lin. No continuous on-shell classification without source-bound envelopes.
original_signed_mode_propagation: Original E_qj10= -sqrt(w_j)/(2*omega_j)*R_j, qx_j10=sqrt(w_j)/omega_j*(i*kfund*m)*z_j10, signed +4 convolution of all +/- six original modes m0..40. Propagate conservative source-weighted errors through every signed mode-pair with no high-frequency deletion or cancellation-dependent relative-only budget.
independent_numerical_scopes: Original Nt128/Nt64, C_min/C_star/C_max, Nq2048/Nq1024 and original Repair26 R1 trace; require original H3F/Repair13 action-consistent continuous H and X10 or independently certified interval enclosures, original D13/D14 signed array equality, original source and boundary SHA locks, signed and unsigned error, separate quadrature/time/drive/propagation error, physical active window.
false_inferences_forbidden: No fitting to lensing or observables, no hard-phase bin relative quadrature error bar, no source-independent original X10 interpolation called exact, no FD4 cancellation result called first-order GE05 on-shell, no automatic full H4 Ward/Z21.
